title: Hash-chain the audit records and verify them
goal: Chain each audit record to its predecessor under the existing HMAC audit key, add a verification command (susi audit verify, optionally since a point in time) that detects a mutated, removed or reordered record, and anchor the chain head periodically so the history is evidence rather than a file the system could rewrite at will. Pin it with a test that mutating one line is detected.
